description.value: Buffalo Trails Coffee House is a family-owned, community-rooted coffee house in Creston that has been part of the Kootenay community since 2008. The business operates its own small-batch artisan roastery and sources ingredients hyper-locally — organic dairy from Kootenay Meadows, meats from Famous Fritz, and seasonal produce from valley fruit stands. The patio hosts a seasonal ice cream parlour called Happy Trails, offering Foothills ice cream, milkshakes, and fresh-squeezed lemonade.
